mapper.select: select * from mountains where name like CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')

select m.*, IFNULL(rc.recommend_cnt, 0) as recommend_cnt from mountains m left join ( select t.mountain_id, COUNT(r.user_id) AS recommend_cnt from tracks t JOIN recommends r on r.track_id = t.id group by t.mountain_id ) rc on rc.mountain_id = m.id order by recommend_Cnt DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into mountains (name, location, height, description, lat, lng, image_source, original_filename, stored_filename) values (#{name}, #{location}, #{height}, #{description}, #{lat}, #{lng}, #{imageSource}, #{originalFilename}, #{storedFilename})
mapper.update: update mountains set name = #{name}, location = #{location}, height = #{height}, description = #{description}, lat = #{lat}, lng = #{lng}, image_source = #{imageSource}, original_filename = #{originalFilename}, stored_filename = #{storedFilename} where id = #{id}
